articles.summary: Carter Bank Strengthens Raleigh Presence with Commercial Banking Leader Kevin Lockhart Lockhart will advance Carter Banks commitment to driving growth across one of the nations fastest-growing cities. FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MARTINSVILLE, Va. (September 15, 2026) Carter Bank (Nasdaq: CARE) is pleased to announce that Kevin Lockhart will lead the Banks commercial banking efforts in Raleigh, N.C. A veteran commercial banker with more than 30 years of experience, Lockhart has spent the past eight years as a Regional Executive overseeing the Roanoke and New River Valley regions in Virginia. Lockhart brings extensive expertise and well-established Raleigh-based business relationships to the role, further bolstering the Banks presence and commitment to creating opportunities for more businesses to prosper in Raleigh, which continues to rank among the nations fastest-growing cities.
